newsitem.title: USA: Third party to buy D & K customer assets.
newsitem.headline: Third party to buy D & K customer assets.

text.p: D & K Wholesale Drug Inc told federal regulators a third party has agreed to buy substantially all of the assets of its largest customer.
In a quarterly filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission released Thursday, the St. Louis, Mo., based company said it has been advised of the deal, but did not indicate the source.
Also if such a purchase is completed, the unnamed interested party would secure a new supplier, the wholesale drugs distributor said.
In June 1997, D & K extended its supply agreement with its largest customer through September 15, 1997.
This customer, also unnamed, represented 18.3 percent and 21.3 percent respectively, of the company's net sales for the three-month periods ended June 30, 1997 and 1996.
D & K said it is uncertain as to the likelihood of the supply pact being extended beyond the current expiration date.
